known_public_status: The Erdős Problems page currently states that #258 has been answered affirmatively using Tao and Teravainen [TaTe25].
normalized_statement: For every positive integer sequence (a_n) with a_n -> infinity, define Q_n=a_1...a_n and S=sum_{n>=1} tau(n)/Q_n. Prove S is irrational.
original_statement: Let a_1,a_2,... be a sequence of positive integers with a_n -> infinity. Is sum_n tau(n)/(a_1...a_n) irrational, where tau(n) is the number of divisors of n?
target: Prove S is irrational by assuming S=A/B, choosing a Tao--Teravainen good N past the denominator threshold, and forcing the cleared positive integer tail I_N to satisfy 0<I_N<1.
title: Erdős Problem #258: irrationality of divisor-function Cantor series with a_n -> infinity
